Privacy policy

Effective date: 24/11/2026 · Applies to the EAS Launcher (eas-launcher.colt98045.workers.dev), EAS Repository US (eas-repository.colt98045.workers.dev) and EAS Repository Canada (eas-repository-ca.colt98045.workers.dev).

The short version

  • When you visit, we log your full IP address, the page or API path, the time, your country, your browser's user agent and the HTTP status.
  • We use these logs only for security and abuse prevention, and to keep the sites running.
  • Logs are kept for 30 days and then deleted automatically.
  • We do not sell or share your personal information, and we do not use it for advertising.
  • There are no accounts for visitors, no analytics trackers and no advertising cookies.

What we collect and why

Visit logs. Each site writes a log entry for page and API requests with: your full IP address, a salted one-way hash of that IP, the path (without query strings), the time, the country Cloudflare derives from your IP, your browser's user agent, the HTTP status and, on the US site, whether the bot check was shown or passed. We use this to detect and block abuse, investigate attacks and outages, and see whether the sites work.

Admin sign-ins. The admin page is protected by Cloudflare Access. Sign-in attempts to it (email, time, IP address, country and whether access was allowed) are recorded by Cloudflare Access and shown to the site administrators. Only invited administrators can sign in.

Bot check (US site). The US site uses Cloudflare Turnstile to check that a visitor is not an automated bot before the site loads. Turnstile processes information about your browser and device to do this, under Cloudflare's Turnstile privacy addendum. After you pass, a strictly necessary first-party cookie (__Host-eas_gate) remembers that for a limited time.

Stored in your browser only. Which announcement banners you dismissed is kept in your browser's session storage. Dashboard settings you choose (such as theme, sound, saved areas, pinned alerts, alert history and the optional dashboard password) are kept in your browser's local storage. This data stays on your device; we never receive it, and you can clear it at any time in your browser.

Who processes it

The sites are hosted on Cloudflare (Workers, D1 and KV). Cloudflare processes requests and stores the logs on our behalf as our service provider and processor; see Cloudflare's privacy policy. Cloudflare may process data in the United States and other countries.

The US and Canada dashboards also load fonts, a map library, map tiles and weather and radar images directly from third parties, including Google Fonts, unpkg, OpenStreetMap, NOAA / National Weather Service and Environment and Climate Change Canada. Your browser contacts those services directly, so they receive your IP address and user agent under their own privacy policies. Weather alert data is fetched from public government feeds.

We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with anyone else, except where the law requires it.

How long we keep it

Visit logs are deleted automatically after 30 days. Admin sign-in records are kept by Cloudflare Access according to Cloudflare's own retention. Data in your browser stays until you clear it.

Your choices and rights

You can ask us what personal information we hold about you, ask us to correct or delete it, or object to how we use it, by emailing colt98045@gmail.com. Tell us roughly when you visited and your IP address so we can find the entries. We will respond within 30 days. Because logs are only kept for 30 days, older entries no longer exist.

Canada (PIPEDA). We collect only what we need for the security and operation purposes above, and we tell you about it here before or when you use the sites. By using the sites you consent to this collection for those purposes; if you do not agree, please do not use them. You can ask to access or correct your information, or withdraw consent for future collection by not using the sites. If you are not satisfied with our answer, you can contact the Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada.

EU and UK (GDPR / UK GDPR). We process visit logs on the basis of our legitimate interests in keeping the sites secure and working. You have the right to access, correct and erase your personal data, to restrict processing, and to object to processing based on legitimate interests. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

California (CCPA / CPRA). We do not sell or share personal information, as those terms are defined in California law, and we do not use it for cross-context behavioural advertising. You have the right to know what personal information we collect and to ask us to delete it, and we will not treat you differently for using these rights.

Children

The sites are not directed at children, and we do not knowingly collect information from children.

Security

Logs are stored in Cloudflare and are readable only by administrators who sign in through Cloudflare Access. No system is perfectly secure, but we limit what we collect and how long we keep it.

Changes and contact

If this policy changes, we will update it here and change the effective date. Questions or requests: colt98045@gmail.com.

This policy describes how these sites handle information. It is not legal advice and is not a certification of compliance with any law.
